scan.scope: Full-row geography discovery in explicitly selected profile, account, organization and billing tables.

limitations: Inventory samples the first nonblank row schema per nested table; gzip integrity is not full JSON validation or source authentication.
This discovery batch selects 11 tables. Other tables, historical snapshots, free text and embedded arrays are outside its row analysis.
Hong Kong country or city/region fields are row-level geography signals, not verified residence, headquarters, employer identity or compromise.
Candidate company rows contain company/account labels and geography in the same record; semantic roles and ownership still require review.
Observations overlap across profiles, snapshots and tables and are not unique people, companies, customers or incidents.
No new company attribution is established by these discovery counts. Tenant-to-cluster joins and historical ownership are reviewed separately.
Counts include only checkpointed tables; a running table is excluded until its processing result is saved.
